description: This file implements a database driver for plugins in the Mattermost server, managing connections, transactions, statements, and rows with thread-safe maps and methods.

classes.name: DriverImpl
classes.description: Implements the plugin.Driver interface, managing database connections, transactions, statements, and rows with thread safety.

classes.name: connMeta
classes.description: Holds metadata for a database connection, including plugin ID and the SQL connection object.

methods.name: NewDriverImpl
methods.description: Creates a new DriverImpl instance with initialized maps and server reference.

methods.name: Conn
methods.description: Establishes a new database connection, returning a connection ID.

methods.name: ConnWithPluginID
methods.description: Establishes a new database connection associated with a specific plugin ID.

methods.name: conn
methods.description: Internal method to get a connection from the database, with optional plugin ID.

methods.name: ConnPing
methods.description: Pings the database connection to check if it is alive.

methods.name: ConnQuery
methods.description: Executes a query on a connection and returns a rows ID.

methods.name: ConnExec
methods.description: Executes a statement on a connection and returns a result container.

methods.name: ConnClose
methods.description: Closes a connection and removes it from the map.

methods.name: ShutdownConns
methods.description: Closes all remaining connections for a given plugin ID.

methods.name: Tx
methods.description: Begins a new transaction on a connection, returning a transaction ID.

methods.name: TxCommit
methods.description: Commits a transaction.

methods.name: TxRollback
methods.description: Rolls back a transaction.

methods.name: Stmt
methods.description: Prepares a statement on a connection, returning a statement ID.

methods.name: StmtClose
methods.description: Closes a prepared statement.

methods.name: StmtNumInput
methods.description: Returns the number of placeholder parameters for a statement.

methods.name: StmtQuery
methods.description: Executes a query statement and returns a rows ID.

methods.name: StmtExec
methods.description: Executes a statement and returns a result container.

methods.name: RowsColumns
methods.description: Returns column names for a result set.

methods.name: RowsClose
methods.description: Closes a result set.

methods.name: RowsNext
methods.description: Advances to the next row in the result set.

methods.name: RowsHasNextResultSet
methods.description: Checks if there is a next result set.

methods.name: RowsNextResultSet
methods.description: Moves to the next result set.

methods.name: RowsColumnTypeDatabaseTypeName
methods.description: Returns the database type name of a column.

methods.name: RowsColumnTypePrecisionScale
methods.description: Returns the precision and scale of a column.
